correctness.rationale: For 2n cyclic vertices, each non-diameter candidate length class is 2-regular with 2n chords; the diameter class is a 1-regular perfect matching with n chords. A prescribed edge occurs with p=1/(2n-1); disjoint edge pair with q=1/[(2n-1)(2n-3)]; overlapping edges cannot co-occur. Counting ordered shared-endpoint pairs (4n within a short class, 8n between shorts, 4n short-diameter, zero diameter-diameter) gives covariance A=4n(n-1)/(2n-1)², B=-8n(n-1)/[(2n-3)(2n-1)²], C=-4n(n-1)/same denominator, D=4n(n-1)²/same denominator. Since sum L_j=n, constant eigenvector eigenvalue0; short-class sum-zero vectors eigenvalue A-B=4n(n-1)/[(2n-3)(2n-1)] multiplicity n-2; diameter contrast eigenvalue D-C=4n²(n-1)/[(2n-3)(2n-1)²]. Weighted-variance isometry follows by orthogonal projection. Independent exact full matching enumerations n=2,..,6 verified all entries and null row sums; n=2 empty short-difference eigenspace handled. Formula for arbitrary n is proved combinatorially.
